description: Authored synthetic inputs for Python/JS selection parity. Compact study selections contain only overview-retained selection facts; no claim IDs.

history.statement: Released, fully supported, and posted on the Web.

dated.method: Release and fix evidence for the selected advisory CVE cohort; releases need not have been published in the selected advisory window. Publisher-reported fixed CVEs and affected-scope linked CVEs are separate observations. Vendor-fixed context follows selected study CVEs; affected-scope links additionally require the selected affected CVE cohort. Remediation availability dates retain advisory context and never supply a software release date; only publisher release-history dates do. Fixed-only statements do not establish affectedness, model applicability, deployed exposure or an upgrade event. Exact literal identities only; no version ordering, first-fix, fix-delay or security ranking inference. Retained sources are a bounded reviewed set, not a complete vendor release archive; coverage denominators are unknown.
